title: Tunaangalia karatasi na kukisia kwamba labda panya alitafuna kebo

text.We look at the papers and guess that may: Tunaangalia karatasi na kukisia kwamba labda panya alitafuna kebo
text.Sometimes, while looking at the papers,: Wakati mwingine, nikiangalia karatasi, mimi pia hufanya kazi sababu ya kosa.
text.When the field worker arrives at the sit: Mfanyakazi wa shamba anapofika kwenye tovuti, jambo la kwanza tunalofanya ni "mgawanyiko wa kwanza".
text.To decide whether the fault is on the eq: Ili kuamua ikiwa hitilafu iko kwenye upande wa kifaa au upande wa kebo, tunapima ikiwa mawimbi ya mwanga, nguvu ya macho, inapitia ipasavyo.
text.If no light is coming and the distance t: Ikiwa hakuna mwanga unaokuja na umbali wa mapumziko ni karibu 0 hadi 10 mita, basi si njia ya nje, ni tatizo ndani ya jengo la mteja.
text.At a site where the cable is run through: Kwenye tovuti ambayo kebo inaendeshwa kupitia dari, mazungumzo wakati mwingine huwa, "labda imetafunwa na panya hapa".
text.While the field worker is measuring on s: Wakati mfanyakazi wa shamba anapima kwenye tovuti, mimi hutazama karatasi zilizo mbele yangu na kupunguza sababu pamoja nazo, nikisema "tafadhali pima hapa ijayo".
text.This feels a little like being a detecti: Hii inahisi kama kuwa mpelelezi, na inafurahisha sana.
text.Network operations also means sending a: Uendeshaji wa mtandao wa pia inamaanisha kutuma mtu halisi kwenye tovuti
text.The police call us to ask who is behind: Polisi wanatupigia simu kutuuliza ni nani aliye nyuma ya anwani ya IP
